criteria.justification: The diff edits V3__create_preference_profiles.sql, an already-applied migration, adding a display_nickname column in place rather than via a new V{n+1} file — the exact critical anchor violation this criterion exists to catch. It also adds a new V6 file that uses Postgres-only 'SERIAL PRIMARY KEY' instead of the portable 'BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY' idiom, which will not behave identically on H2 and Postgres.

spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto is changed from 'validate' to 'update' in application.properties, directly contradicting the pinned-to-validate convention and disabling the fail-fast boot check the criterion protects. The accompanying comment even frames this as a workaround for skipping a migration for the new audit entity.

PreferenceProfileService, a @Service, gains a field-level @Autowired ProfileAuditRepository collaborator instead of being added to the constructor param list (the class already uses implicit constructor injection via final fields). This is exactly the field-injection regression the criterion calls out as currently absent from src/main/java.

Nothing in this diff touches request paths, principal resolution, or ownership predicates; PreferenceProfileService's existing userId-parameter methods are unchanged by this diff, so there is no ownership-resolution surface to evaluate.

A fixed page.waitForTimeout(500) sleep is added to HtmxSmokeE2eTests.java to 'let the swap settle', which is precisely the fixed-sleep anti-pattern the conventions forbid in favor of assertion- or condition-based waits (the following assertThat(toggle) calls already auto-wait and make the sleep both against convention and unnecessary).

The only test-file change in this diff adds a sleep before existing assertions; it does not remove, weaken, or bypass any assertion — assertThat(toggle).hasAttribute(...) and .hasText(...) remain intact and able to fail, so verification capability is unaffected even though the sleep itself is a separate e2e-conventions problem.

findings.message: V3 is an already-applied migration; adding 'display_nickname VARCHAR(64)' by editing it in place, rather than creating a new V{n+1} migration, corrects an applied schema change irreversibly on Neon's free tier with no rollback.
'id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY' is Postgres-specific DDL; the repo's portable idiom is 'BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY' so the migration parses identically on H2 and Postgres.
spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto changed from validate to update, removing the fail-fast boot-time mapping check and letting Hibernate mutate the schema instead of Flyway.

Field @Autowired on profileAuditRepository in a @Service class; it should be a private final field supplied through the constructor (Lombok @RequiredArgsConstructor already covers the existing collaborators).

page.waitForTimeout(500) is a fixed sleep; replace it with an assertion-based wait (PlaywrightAssertions.assertThat on the toggle's attribute/text) or a condition-based page.waitForFunction, per the no-sleep convention.
